controls.label: Initial split
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Sets automatic seam/start value and reduced-motion static value; clamped inside sweep range.
controls.renderConsequence: Moves divider and before clip to the same scalar.
controls.causalTest: At t=0 and t=1, split equals the authored value; media rectangles remain unchanged.

controls.label: Sweep range
controls.persistence: One coherent object with ordered min/max; exact decimal round-trip.
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Defines automatic extrema and ARIA/manual Home/End bounds.
controls.renderConsequence: Limits clip and handle travel without changing content rectangle.
controls.causalTest: Max/min holds equal exact bounds and both turnaround velocities equal zero.

controls.label: Sweep duration
controls.evaluatorConsequence: Allocates travel segments before normalized compilation.
controls.renderConsequence: Changes divider speed only; holds and source state remain invariant.
controls.causalTest: Doubling value halves peak split velocity within tolerance while extrema remain equal.

controls.label: Turnaround hold
controls.renderConsequence: Changes dwell only; no source or handle styling changes.
controls.causalTest: Boundary samples remain exact extrema and hold duration changes by requested amount.

controls.label: Comparison chrome
controls.evaluatorConsequence: No motion consequence; declares presentation visibility state.
controls.renderConsequence: Shows labels and handle, handle only, or divider only.
controls.causalTest: DOM visibility matches option while split and source hashes remain identical.
